justification: Bernard's on his bye, Pittsburgh's not playing this week, and I don't suit up a guy who ain't even got a locker room to walk into — Malik Washington steps in at WR1, he's been touching the ball in Miami every week, that's a trade I make every time. Breece Hall's Questionable again and I give him the respect of the two-and-a-half, but Jonah Coleman's sitting there at thirteen clean points with no tag next to his name, and that's not close enough for loyalty to win the argument — Coleman gets the flex, Hall waits his turn on my bench same as he's done before. Kyler Murray's Questionable too, but he's my guy, he's been showing up hurt all year and a tag don't scare me off a quarterback who's thrown for two scores his last time out — he starts. Javonte, Chase Brown, LaPorta, Cooper, the kicker, and the Seattle D haven't done a thing to lose their chairs, so they ride as-is. Two-and-six stings and everybody in this family knows it, but I don't bench a man for a number on a page, I bench him when somebody better's actually standing in the kitchen — today somebody was.
forum_post: Leon's out there strutting like his gut's never been wrong, 6-and-2, Burrow throwing for the moon. Respect the stones, I do, I'm not blind. But stones don't win in overtime and they definitely don't win when my backfield's got two guys who run angry and your defense is gonna find that out personal. Talk loud all you want this week, Leon — Sunday's when the talking stops and the counting starts.
